budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY15 budget will include more funding for the senior center food program; no amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: the fy15 budget will include more funding to impro ve the food program at the senior center.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Gardener Helen Balcom will be paid through Town Funds and funds from the Supporters of the Eagle House Inc.; no amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: she will be paid through town funds along with funds from the supporters of the eagle house inc.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Meeting approved Capital Plan funding for new carpeting and new tile flooring at the Eagle House; no amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: along with new tile flooring in the original section of the building.

budget_items.topic: Eagle House evening hours and staffing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Five hours were added to the Administrative Assistant/Dispatcher hours for Tuesday and Thursday evenings, and the Town is reimbursed through MART for driver salary.
budget_items.quote: 5 hours have been ad ded to the administrative assistant/dispatcher hour s to cover reservations during that time.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director is investigating a User's Fee for non-residents, equivalent to the Formula Grant funding the Town receives per elder each year.
budget_items.quote: a user's fee of approximately $8 per year

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Judith Lindstedt will no longer conduct Exercise Class at the Eagle House because of the $200 user fee, which the board heard about as unreasonable.
budget_items.quote: due to the unreasonable demand of a $200 user fee.
